commit.message: feat(makehtml): add safeMode and harden the converter against XSS and ReDoS Add a new `safeMode` option (default off) providing defense-in-depth for untrusted Markdown: an opt-in URL-scheme allowlist that neutralizes `javascript:`/`vbscript:`/`data:text/html` in generated and raw links/images (resolving entity/whitespace/`>`-in-attribute obfuscations, keeping `data:image/*`), plus escaping of raw HTML tags and stripping of inline event-handler attributes regardless of separator. Harden output encoding unconditionally: - metadata values are HTML-escaped before insertion into the document head, so front-matter can no longer break out of ``/`<meta>`; - attribute values are quote-escaped at emit time; - makeMarkdown escapes emitted destinations/titles (no round-trip injection) and parses input in an inert document (no `<img onerror>`/script execution). Eliminate catastrophic-backtracking / quadratic parsing (ReDoS) in the link, image, heading, table, footnote and raw-HTML-span parsers, and replace the per-span unhash loop with a single linear pass. All changes are behavior preserving; the link/image destination and HTML-span scanning are now linear.
